# North East Inner City (NEIC)

> > Dublin's North East Inner City initiative supporting community development, safety, education, and wellbeing through integrated local programmes.

NEIC coordinates community services across Dublin's North East Inner City through partnerships like the City Connects Programme, Local Community Safety Partnership, and specialized initiatives in parenting, intercultural development, arts, and sports. The Programme Implementation Board oversees strategic development and resource allocation for this area-based intervention.
